headline: History niches now scored; mythology and folklore leads them at 90
paragraphs: Today's run fetched 400 channels and filled in history and story niches that had 0 to 6 channels yesterday. Jumps such as history-documentary 38 to 82 and aviation 10 to 83 come from larger samples, not a market shift. Money niches moved by 1 point or less.

Highest scores: real estate investing 94, personal finance 92, mythology and folklore 90. Biggest outliers: a Regent International rise-and-fall video (7,199.8x, 3,866,281 views, 90,300 subscribers) and a WWII video from a 3,140-subscriber channel (4,733.3x, 2,092,119 views).

Added three niches to track: no-code-automation, robotics-humanoids and archival-restoration, the last echoing Restored Century's three videos in the military-ww2 niche at 132.8x to 232.4x. Thumbnails could not be loaded today, so verdicts and notes rely on titles.
